verdict.rationale: llamafile is a local LLM runtime and server, so paged KV-cache memory management is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions paged attention, KV-cache paging, or fragmentation-free allocation. The server reference only lists generic "slot" options, which is not evidence of paged memory management.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on paged memory management for attention key/value cache to maximize concurrent request capacity without memory fragmentation
